tracks.style_prompt: Dark Japanese cinematic electronic symphonic rock boss song, 136 BPM, F-sharp minor. One dignified clear female mezzo-soprano, precise Japanese diction, composed and caring at first, gradually exhausted and fragile, never villainous. Violin and French horns carry a recurring descending motif over mechanical electronic pulse, low strings, deep bass and powerful restrained drums. Begin with sparse silver-toned harmonics; each verse accumulates darker chords, dissonant string countermelodies and gritty synth layers, like absorbed pain staining the singer from within. Strong haunting hook on 光が、重い; distinct rhythmic phrasing for 祓って、かばって、黙って. Full-length four-minute narrative, sing every supplied line. Bridge strips to piano and a trembling close vocal, final chorus becomes crushing without obscuring the words. Outro falls to an exposed quiet plea and unresolved instrumental decay. Clear vocal, controlled dynamics, complete ending, no triumphant resolution.
tracks.exclude: male vocals, idol chants, crowd cheers, cute baby voice, rap, English lyrics, triumphant ending
